ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of high-intensity textured grey/white pixels to low-intensity black pigmentation pixels across the visible ventral plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity (black) region extending from the peduncle to the lower-mid lobes. High-intensity (white/grey) mottling dominates the distal regions of both lobes. Distinct dark circular pixel clusters (approx. 4-6 per lobe) are visible in the upper-outer quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary, with distinct sharp peaks localized towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature transitioning from the median notch toward the distal tips, characterized by an increasing slope gradient.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast calcified structures (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal tips and intermittently along the leading edge (bottom boundary).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single high-intensity linear mark (approx. 40 pixels in length) visible within the left-central dark pigment zone, associated with a circular focal scar.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization on both distal lobe tips; notable circular white scar with trailing linear scratch on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy white punctate scarring and rake-like striations overlaid on the grey-white mottled regions of the outer lobes.
